title: Valuing Used Visits on a Cancelled Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Bought at a Household Discount
content:
**Refund note — used visits on cancelled prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon passes** (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes).

The value of the used visits on a cancelled pass follows the discount recorded at purchase and how far into its validity the pass is cancelled, counted in whole calendar months from the purchase date to the cancellation date:

1. A pass bought with the multi-pet or the wellness-plan discount and cancelled before half (0.5) of its validity in months has passed values every used visit at the undiscounted rate — the per-visit paid rate divided by one minus that discount percentage.
2. A pass bought with the multi-pet or the wellness-plan discount, cancelled once half of its validity in months has passed and holding at least one used visit, values its most recent used visit at that undiscounted rate and every other used visit at the per-visit paid rate.
3. Any other pass values every used visit at the per-visit paid rate.

The per-visit paid rate is the price paid divided by the visits purchased; a used visit is a completed visit, a no-show or a forfeit taking one visit. The value of the used visits is what is taken from the price paid to leave the unused value.

**Figures by pass**

| Pass | Validity | Half of validity | Multi-pet discount | Wellness-plan discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 6 months | 3 whole months | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 12 months | 6 whole months | 5 percent | 0 percent |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 12 months | 6 whole months | 10 percent | 5 percent |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 12 months | 6 whole months | 10 percent | 5 percent |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 12 months | 6 whole months | 10 percent | 5 percent |

(Groom Club Monthly, with a 1-month validity and no discounts, is not a prepaid pass and is not refunded on this basis.)

**Decision table**

| Discount recorded at purchase | Whole months from purchase to cancellation | Used visits valued |
|---|---|---|
| multi-pet or wellness plan | fewer than half of validity | all at the undiscounted rate |
| multi-pet or wellness plan | half of validity or more, at least one used visit | most recent at the undiscounted rate, the rest at the paid rate |
| online, or none | any | all at the paid rate |

**Worked example (hypothetical Full Groom Pass 6-Visit, list price 428.40, multi-pet discount of 10 percent, price paid 385.56, two used visits)**

- Per-visit paid rate: 385.56 divided by 6, that is 64.26. Undiscounted rate: 64.26 divided by 0.9, that is 71.40.
- Cancelled 4 whole months after purchase: both used visits at 71.40, used value 142.80, unused value 242.76.
- Cancelled 7 whole months after purchase: one visit at 71.40 and one at 64.26, used value 135.66, unused value 249.90.
- The same pass bought with the online discount: both visits at the paid rate whatever the timing.
